scientific_question: Can layer-private 4-bit-per-weight Euclidean pair coding preserve the dense teacher's complete MLP value and derivative fields while retaining about 4x persistent BF16 matrix-state compression and no dense master, ambient residual, or optimizer state?

causal_basis.failed_point: One uint8 signed direction and one BF16 amplitude per 16 weights recovered 48.04% matrix energy, 24.53% mean output energy, 23.99% mean input-JVP energy, and incurred +5.6791 fixed CE at 10.47x storage compression.
causal_basis.rate_distortion_diagnosis: For locally isotropic d-dimensional blocks with R direction bits, normalized squared distortion is approximately 2^(-2R/d). R=8 and d=16 predicts 50% recovery, matching the measurement; amplitude tuning cannot repair the missing angular rate.
causal_basis.representation_change: Partition each layer-private c_fc and c_proj into contiguous two-value vectors. Fit an independent 256-entry Euclidean BF16 codebook for every layer and matrix side and store one uint8 code per pair. Codewords contain both direction and magnitude, so no block amplitude is stored.
causal_basis.why_this_single_rate: Eight bits per two weights is exactly four bits per weight. The same rate-distortion approximation predicts 1-2^(-8)=99.609% energy recovery, while the persistent state remains almost 4x smaller than dense BF16. This is the smallest theory-selected relaxation with a credible chance of satisfying the fixed CE gate; it is not a block-size or bit-width sweep.
causal_basis.why_high_freedom: Every weight pair makes an independent layer-private combinatorial choice among 256 learned vectors. The decoded matrices have no shared-layer orbit, low-rank constraint, fixed orthogonal image, or common amplitude field.

quantizer.codebook_scope: independent for every layer and matrix side
quantizer.fit: deterministic Euclidean Lloyd clustering on a fixed random sample, then exact nearest-codeword assignment of every pair

decision_rule.pass: Design one discrete-code training rule with no dense master or ambient error buffer, measure exact optimizer-state bytes and MFU, and only then authorize one 124M/0.5TPP LM run.
decision_rule.fail: Reject this exact four-bit pair-code family. Use the matrix/function/CE discriminator to decide whether any discrete code family remains scientifically justified; do not sweep dimensions or bits.
decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: Repair only the implementation defect and rerun the immutable plan without inspecting partial scientific metrics.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run one zero-LM-update dense-teacher pair-VQ ceiling after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before every gate passes
dense FP16/FP32 master weights, residuals, momentum, or error feedback
vector-length, bit-width, codebook-size, sample-size, iteration, seed, or optimizer sweeps
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if measured complete runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
